import pytest
class Results:
    passed = 0
    skipped = 0
    xfailed = 0
    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report):
        if report.when == 'call':
            if report.passed: self.passed += 1
            elif report.skipped and hasattr(report, 'wasxfail'): self.xfailed += 1
            elif report.skipped: self.skipped += 1
results = Results()
exit_code = pytest.main(['-q','--strict-markers','--strict-config','tests/test_runtime_receipt_readiness.py','tests/test_runtime_audit.py','tests/test_proof_reuse.py','tests/test_review_audits.py','tests/test_capability_evidence.py'], plugins=[results])
assert exit_code == 0
assert (results.passed, results.skipped, results.xfailed) == (90, 0, 0)
print('READINESS_PASS')
